releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.7.0 — Micro-Thread Priority Gating for Anti-Cheat & DRM:
- Anti-Cheat Priority Demotion: Automatically demotes background memory polling services (EasyAntiCheat, BattlEye, Riot Vanguard, EA Javelin, PunkBuster, ACE) to BELOW_NORMAL priority and pins them to secondary CPU cores.
- Main Game High Priority: Elevates the active foreground game's rendering thread to HIGH_PRIORITY_CLASS across all 12 CPU cores.
- Eliminates CPU voltage spikes and improves 1% low frametimes.
- Direct DWM Composition Bypass (DirectFlip & Flip Queue = 1).
- Dynamic Power Budget Ratio Optimizer (CPU vs GPU Rebalancing).
- Resolution Scale & FSR/NIS Automator.
- Kernel DPC Latency Watchdog & audiodg.exe Pro-Audio Lock.
